statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-37769 is a floating point exception found by running pixman's own stress-test fuzz harness against combine_inner in pixman-combine-float.c; the harness is test code that is not shipped (dpkg -L libpixman-1-0 lists only the libpixman-1.so.0 shared library) and the Debian security tracker marks the issue unimportant. In this image pixman is exercised only by cairo for GTK UI compositing; web and test content rasterizes through chromium's bundled Skia, so there is no adversarial input path into the affected combiner.
